title: Fixed Targets vs Structure-Based Targets
hook: More flexible does not automatically mean more advanced.

launchpad.outcome: Understand fixed and structure-based management, and judge actions against the plan each trader started with.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Did the action match the predefined model?

beats.title: An example, not a rule
beats.line: Not universal futures risk. Not what every student should risk.

slides.heading: Structure-based management

beats.title: Uses market information
beats.line: Previous highs and lows, external swings, liquidity, new structure.

beats.title: More adaptive
beats.line: It can respond to what price builds.

beats.title: More discretion
beats.line: Undefined discretion is where emotion gets in.

slides.punch: MORE FLEXIBLE DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY MEAN MORE ADVANCED.

slides.title: Watch both traders

tabs.name: FIXED MODEL

events.text: +31: nothing in a fixed plan triggers. They hold.

tabs.result: Held the whole time, exactly as planned.

plan.structuralRules: Trail SL under each new 1M HL above +20

events.text: +19 after a push to +31: a new 1M higher low. Their rule: trail the stop to 20,018.

ask.prompt: They managed the same price differently. Is one of them wrong?

options.label: Yes, the fixed trader ignored new structure
options.feedback: Their plan never said to use structure. They followed it.

options.label: Yes, the structure trader touched their stop
options.feedback: Their plan said to trail after a new HL. Rule-based.

options.label: No: each action matched their predefined model
options.why: Different plans can make different legitimate decisions.

slides.punch: DID THE ACTION MATCH THE PREDEFINED MODEL?

slides.quote: Different action doesn’t mean somebody’s wrong. Ask whether it matched the plan they started with.

slides.prompt: What’s the difference between fixed and structure-based management?
slides.modelAnswer: Fixed management holds to a predefined stop and target. Structure-based management adapts to new market information, which needs more discretion, so its rules have to be defined just as clearly.

takeaways: Judge the action against the plan.
remember: More flexible does not automatically mean more advanced.
